description: City of New York Municipal Solar-Readiness Assessment (Local Law 24 of 2016) data is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. These data were prepared in compliance with the requirements of Local Law 24 of 2016 (LL24). Under LL24, the Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS) is required to assess the solar photovoltaic (PV) potential of all City-owned buildings over 10,000 gross square feet once every two years. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are pv, roof assessment, solar, sustainability, emission. The table has 32 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS). The portal shows 2026-04-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
